title: Deliver Iron Ore to Bunfingbridge Steel Mill
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Iron Ore** delivered to **Bunfingbridge Steel Mill** (industry id 6, near tile 81,56).

A likely supplier is **Peninghall Iron Ore Mine** (industry id 9, near tile 52,72); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.
